title: TransGHOST: Real-Time, Synthesis-Free Reconstruction of Instrument-Occluded Regions in Ophthalmic Microsurgery
abstract: arXiv:2611.13971v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intraoperative scene perception in ophthalmic microsurgery is limited by instrument occlusion: when a tool enters the high-magnification field, it conceals tissue from both the surgeon and the perception components of robot-assisted systems that process the video. Generative inpainting can remove the occluder but replaces the missing image content with synthesis, which is unsuitable when visual provenance matters. Many video inpainters also depend on future frames and cannot operate online. We present TransGHOST, a causal reference-guided reconstruction pipeline whose non-generative safe mode operates in real time. Every restored value is obtained by resampling a recorded frame using geometric transforms fitted only to visible regions. The system provides per-pixel confidence and provenance and marks unsupported pixels as abstentions. We evaluate TransGHOST on a new veterinary clinical corpus of canine cataract surgery with pixel-level

translated_title: TransGHOST：眼科显微手术中器械遮挡区域的实时、无合成重建
translated_abstract: 眼科显微手术中的术中场景感知受到器械遮挡的限制：当器械进入高倍放大视野时，它同时遮挡了术者和处理视频的机器人辅助系统感知组件所看到的组织。生成式图像修复可以去除遮挡物，但会用合成内容替换缺失的图像内容，这在视觉来源可追溯性至关重要的情况下并不适用。此外，许多视频修复方法依赖于未来帧，无法在线运行。我们提出了TransGHOST，一种因果的、参考引导的重建流水线，其非生成的安全模式可实时运行。每一个恢复的像素值都是通过使用仅拟合于可见区域的几何变换对已录制的帧进行重采样而获得的。该系统提供逐像素的置信度和来源信息，并将无法支撑（追溯）的像素标记为弃权。我们在一个新的犬类白内障手术兽医临床数据集上，以像素级（精度）对TransGHOST进行了评估。
tldr: TransGHOST提出了一种实时、非生成的因果参考引导重建流水线，通过仅基于可见区域拟合的几何变换从历史帧重采样来恢复眼科显微手术中被器械遮挡的区域，并提供逐像素置信度与来源标注，从而避免了生成式修复带来的合成内容与不可追溯问题。
en_tdlr: TransGHOST is a real-time, synthesis-free, causal reference-guided reconstruction pipeline that restores instrument-occluded regions in ophthalmic microsurgery by resampling recorded frames using geometric transforms fitted only to visible regions, providing per-pixel confidence and provenance instead of generative synthesis.
